policy_title: Clinical Policy CP.MP.107: Durable Medical Equipment and Orthotics and Prosthetics Guidelines (Rev. 08/26)
source_quote: Medically necessary when breast pumps are a covered benefit for the member/enrollee.

criteria.description: Breast pump is a covered plan benefit

review_notes: Coverage is dependent upon individual plan benefit design.

policy_title: Clinical Policy CP.MP.107: Durable Medical Equipment and Orthotics and Prosthetics Guidelines (Rev. 08/26)
source_quote: Medically necessary when meeting all of the following: A. Standard bed or standard hospital bed is unable to meet positioning needs due to disability; B. Less intensive alternatives to improve the member/enrollee’s safety have been tried and ruled out (to include documentation of why medical needs could not be met).

criteria.description: Standard bed/hospital bed unable to meet positioning needs due to disability
Less intensive safety alternatives tried and ruled out
Qualifying diagnosis (CP, developmental delay, genetic/neuro disorder, seizure, severe behavior)
PT/OT home evaluation, functional status, and caregiver education documented
Itemized invoice and model specifications provided

required_documentation: PT/OT functional evaluation and home safety assessment
Documentation ruling out rails, floor mattresses, alarms, monitors, calming routines
review_notes: Requires mandatory secondary review by medical director and/or therapy advisor.

policy_title: Clinical Policy CP.MP.107: Durable Medical Equipment and Orthotics and Prosthetics Guidelines (Rev. 08/26)
source_quote: All requests for enclosed beds require mandatory secondary review by a medical director and/or therapy advisor.

criteria.description: Medical director and/or therapy advisor secondary review conducted

review_notes: Mandatory peer-to-peer / medical director secondary review gateway.

policy_title: Clinical Policy CP.MP.107: Durable Medical Equipment and Orthotics and Prosthetics Guidelines (Rev. 08/26)
source_quote: Medically necessary when all of the following are met: A. Documentation of therapist evaluation and ongoing treatment plan; B. Commercial device must be unable to meet the positioning needs due to height, weight, or disability; C. Other positioning devices in the home must be reviewed to ensure duplication of devices are not already in place.

criteria.description: Therapist evaluation and ongoing treatment plan documented
Commercial device unable to meet positioning needs due to height, weight, or disability
Home positioning devices reviewed to ensure no duplication

required_documentation: Inventory of existing seating/positioning devices in the home
review_notes: Requires mandatory secondary review by medical director or therapy advisor.

policy_title: Clinical Policy CP.MP.107: Durable Medical Equipment and Orthotics and Prosthetics Guidelines (Rev. 08/26)
source_quote: Requests for not otherwise specified supplies or miscellaneous equipment codes require mandatory secondary review by a medical director and/or therapy advisor to determine medical necessity.
clinical_service_or_procedure: Specialized supply or miscellaneous equipment (HCPCS E0240, T2028, T2029, K0108, K0739, E1399)

criteria.description: Secondary review completed by medical director or therapy advisor

dependencies: CP.MP.99 Wheelchair Seating for seating requests
review_notes: All NOC/miscellaneous equipment codes require secondary medical director review.

policy_title: Clinical Policy CP.MP.107: Durable Medical Equipment and Orthotics and Prosthetics Guidelines (Rev. 08/26)
source_quote: Not medically necessary, as there is insufficient evidence in published peer-reviewed literature to support the use of this technology over currently available alternatives.

criteria.description: Request is for ROMTech PortableConnect Device

review_notes: Explicit non-coverage determination based on lack of evidence.

policy_title: Clinical Policy CP.MP.107: Durable Medical Equipment and Orthotics and Prosthetics Guidelines (Rev. 08/26)
source_quote: Medically necessary when all of the following are met: A. Musculoskeletal or neurologic impairment requiring traction equipment; B. One of the following: 1. Diagnosis of temporomandibular joint (TMJ) dysfunction and has received treatment for TMJ condition; 2. Distortion of the lower jaw and neck anatomy (e.g. radical neck dissection) such that a chin halter is unable to be utilized; 3. The treating physician orders and/or documents the medical necessity for greater than 20 pounds of cervical traction in the home setting.

criteria.description: Musculoskeletal or neurologic impairment requiring traction
TMJ dysfunction treated, lower jaw/neck distortion precluding chin halter, or >20 lbs home traction ordered

required_documentation: Clinical records documenting TMJ treatment or anatomical distortion
review_notes: E0849 indicated when chin halter cannot be used or >20 lbs ordered.

policy_title: Clinical Policy CP.MP.107: Durable Medical Equipment and Orthotics and Prosthetics Guidelines (Rev. 08/26)
source_quote: Requests for custom molded cervical collars require mandatory secondary review by a medical director and/or therapy advisor to determine medical necessity. Documentation accompanying the request must state the reason why a prefabricated collar is not adequate.
clinical_service_or_procedure: Cervical collar, custom molded (HCPCS L0170, L0190, L0200)

criteria.description: Documentation states why prefabricated collar is not adequate
Mandatory secondary review completed by medical director or therapy advisor

required_documentation: Physician/orthotist documentation stating why prefabricated collar fails
Anatomical measurements or structural deformity findings
review_notes: Mandatory secondary review requirement for custom molded cervical collars.

policy_title: Clinical Policy CP.MP.107: Durable Medical Equipment and Orthotics and Prosthetics Guidelines (Rev. 08/26)
source_quote: Requests for spinal orthotics will be reviewed using relevant nationally recognized decision support tool criteria for similar codes.
clinical_service_or_procedure: Spinal Orthotics (HCPCS L0700, L0710, L0720, L0999, L1000, L1001, L1005, L1006)

criteria.description: Evaluated against relevant nationally recognized decision support tool criteria (InterQual)

review_notes: Defers to nationally recognized clinical decision support tools (InterQual).

policy_title: Clinical Policy CP.MP.107: Durable Medical Equipment and Orthotics and Prosthetics Guidelines (Rev. 08/26)
source_quote: Medically necessary when ordered by an orthopedic surgeon for treatment of, or postoperatively for any of the following: A. Total hip arthroplasty; B. Hip labral tear; C. Hip disorders in children when used to stabilize the hip and/or to correct and maintain hip abduction.
clinical_service_or_procedure: Hip orthotics (HCPCS L1640, L1680, L1685, L1686, L1690)

criteria.description: Total hip arthroplasty, labral tear, or pediatric hip disorder requiring abduction

required_documentation: Orthopedic surgeon operative report or clinic note
Prescription specifying hip stabilization or abduction
review_notes: Lateral replacements due to growth are medically necessary in pediatrics.
